method: Area-weighted mean of the PlanD annual 500 m occurrence tables for every cell whose HK1980 rectangle intersects the study window's HK1980 bounding box. The weight is that intersection area. It is not a new measurement and it is not a velocity.

merged.derivedMeanSpeedMethod: Frequency-weighted midpoint of the area-weighted speed bins. PlanD does not publish a window mean; this figure is calculated from the occurrence tables and is not a measurement of its own.

provenance.dataset: Planning Department Site Wind Availability Data

whatThisIsNot: Not a velocity ratio and not a model result.
Not a replacement for the centroid cell in hsk_site_wind.json. directionWeights=site still reads that cell.
The corridor cost does not use these frequencies. directionWeights=window selects the headline corridor only.
